description: Volunteer management system for nonprofit CASA, which serves foster youth in counties across America.

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

### User facing changes - summary
[Admins] fix timezone on the list of "Sent Emails" under Edit Organization -> Court Details
[All] Add real user testimonials to the main page 
[Volunteers, All] Improve filtering and default order of contacts on the view case contacts page
[Supervisors, Admins] When creating or updating a case, there is now an option to select and unselect all contact type options, which defaults to selecting all options when creating a case. 

### User facing changes - commit messages
* CaseContact validates usage and spec changes - case contact form prep by @thejonroberts in https://github.com/rubyforgood/casa/pull/6061
* 6026: Improve timezones on org settings sent emails by @panacotar in https://github.com/rubyforgood/casa/pull/6043
* Case Contact Form Overhaul by @thejonroberts in https://github.com/rubyforgood/casa/pull/6048
* Add text testimonials, addressing #4407 by @jonathanmeneses in https://github.com/rubyforgood/casa/pull/6097
* bug(case_contact): fixed the order of case contacts by @Raushan998 in https://github.com/rubyforgood/casa/pull/6148

A CASA (Court Appointed Special Advocate) is a role where a volunteer advocates on behalf of a youth in their county's foster care system. CASA is also the namesake role of the national organization, CASA, which exists to cultivate and supervise volunteers carrying out this work – with county level chapters (operating relatively independently of each other) across the country.
